name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Employment

requirements.blocker_text: The employer must register the vacancy with the local Employment Service, which within 1 month issues either a work permit or a decision that the job matches Lithuanian labour-market needs (decided within 7 working days). Certain worker categories are exempt from this labour-market test but still need a residence permit.
A formal employment contract with a registered Lithuanian employer is required.

outcome.duration_length: up to 2 years (matching the work permit's maximum duration), renewable

sources.title: European Commission EU Immigration Portal -- Lithuania employed-worker page: Employment Service labour-market test/decision (7 working days), Migration Department residence permit processing (up to 4 months, 2 months expedited), work permit maximum 2 years
